normalized.description: The Pact for Research and Innovation in Europe (Pact for R&I) foresees that the EU Member States and the Commission implement an enhanced monitoring mechanism to ensure a proper basis for evidence-informed policy making in the European Research Area (ERA). This new ERA monitoring mechanism requires the preparation of the following instruments: an annual ERA scoreboard, an annual ERA dashboard, an EU-level progress report every 18 months, and annual ERA country reports. The purpose of the contract resulting from this procedure is to produce these reports with a view to provide policy makers, R&I practitioners and all interested public with solid analytical tools to monitor and evaluate progress towards the ERA objectives (as set out on the Pact for R&I) and to assess the state-of-play of the implementation of the ERA policy agenda.
